zab lam thugs kyi nor bu'i brgyud 'debs nyung bsdus bzhugs so/ /rigs kun bdag nyid mgon po 'od dpag med/ /'gro drug don mdzad 'phags pa spyan

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250zab lam thugs kyi nor bu'i brgyud 'debs nyung bsdus bzhugs so// 1$0000300rigs kun bdag nyid mgon po 'od dpag med// 'gro drug don mdzad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// rgyal kun thugs rje'i rnam rol pad+ma 'byung*// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo mkhar chen bza'// rgyal sras lha rje ye shes mchog grub rgyal// ngam 'bre'i rigs 'khrungs ar+ya sa le 'od// mi brjed gzungs thob ldan ma rtse mang zhabs// a ti'i bstan bdag bsam gtan rdo rje gling*// zab gter mnga' bdag o rgyan chos rje gling*// rnam thar rmad byung tre chen chos kyi dbang*// mkhyen gnyis rtsal rdzogs bstan pa'i nyin mor byed// pad dkar 'chang dngos bdud 'dul rdo rje 'dzin// gu rus lung bstan skyes chen chos kyi bdag /zab lam gdams pa nor bu'i phreng 'dzin pa'i// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// smin grol dbang dang dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol// byin rlabs kun 'byung gu ru rin po che// dngos grub stsol phyir yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshul// bka' srung gter bdag rnams la gsol ba 'debs// smin grol dbang dang dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol// rang rgyud legs sbyangs zab mo'i snod du rung*// dbang bzhis rgyud smin snang stong bskyed rim 'byongs// thabs lam mthar phyin ka dag lta ba rtogs// lhun grub sgom pa tshad phebs byin gyis rlobs// rig 'dzin rgyal ba rnams la gsol btab mthus// zab lam bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*// bdag gzhan 'gro kun don gnyis lhun grub ste// rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob zin par byin gyis rlobs//
zhes gter chen nyid kyis mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs rgyas pa las khyer bde ba'i phyir pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas kyis nyung ngur bsdus pa dge legs 'phel// //
